title: Escort Fare Schedule — RideLink Alternative Rides after a Late Pickup
content:
Escorts who travel with a member add to the fare of a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation alternative ride taken after a late pickup.

**Rule.** Escorts who rode add an escort fare, the escorts being counted as persons, the most recorded on any one of the trip's registered legs: two or more escorts add the family escort fare of 5.50 USD; one escort adds the single escort fare of 2.75 USD; no escort adds none.

## Escort table

| Most escorts recorded on any one registered leg of the trip | Escort fare |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 5.50 USD |
| 1 | 2.75 USD |
| None | None |

## Questions the rule answers

- *Hypothetical:* **the outbound leg recorded 1 escort and the return leg 2 — which fare applies?** The most on any one leg is 2, so 5.50 USD.
- *Hypothetical:* **each leg recorded 1 escort — is that two escorts?** No; the escorts are the most on any one leg, 1, so 2.75 USD.
- **Is the escort fare charged per mile?** No; it is one flat addition to the fare.
